name: Trust Data Center
notes: Operator site describes the Damascus facility as the largest Tier III data center in the market with a 450 square meter computer room and N+1/modular design; DataCenterMap lists the Baramkeh Ave Damascus facility and reports 1.6 MW IT load.

name: Syria National Data Center
developer: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology
notes: SANA reported completion of the National Data Center and expansion of government cloud services. Ramico later said it commissioned a central power-continuity unit at the National Data Center. Exact site location was not disclosed; assigned to Damascus because SANA dateline and ministry/government functions are in the capital.

name: GO Telecom Syria data centers framework
developer: Etihad Atheeb Telecommunications Co. (GO Telecom) / Ministry of Communications and Information Technology
notes: Listed-company announcement says the five-year framework includes establishment of two data centers, cloud/backup environment, technology platform and cybersecurity center with possible value of SAR 1.955 billion. Specific data-center sites were not disclosed; Damascus assignment is provisional because the ministry counterparty and signing forum were in Damascus.

name: SilkLink Damascus digital infrastructure/data-center node
notes: Official and trade sources describe the SAR 3 billion SilkLink program as a 4,500 km Syrian fiber network with data centers and international submarine cable stations; secondary route detail identifies Damascus as one of the major connected cities. Exact data-center siting is not public, so this is a provisional city-node record.

name: Salam Telecom Aleppo data center
notes: At Shahba Tech 2026 in Aleppo, SANA quoted Salam Telecom's administrative manager saying the company is preparing to launch a Data Center described as the first of its kind in the region, alongside telecom projects with national mobile operators.

name: SilkLink Aleppo digital infrastructure/data-center node
notes: SilkLink sources state the national project includes data centers and a 4,500 km network; route descriptions name Aleppo among major connected cities. Exact data-center siting is not public, so this is a provisional city-node record rather than a confirmed facility address.
